content.text:
## Answers to the four questions

1. **Edit window:** 30 minutes after the comment was created (`policy-edit-window.md`). After that the API refuses the edit.
2. **Edited marker:** A nullable `editedAt` timestamp, null until the first edit, set to the edit time on each successful edit. The migration that adds it must not change existing rows (`policy-edited-at-marker.md`).
3. **Error shape:** The body is an object with an `errors` key that maps a field name to a list of messages, with no wrapper (`policy-error-response.md`). Status codes: validation uses 422, a missing or bad token uses 401, and other errors use 500 (`code-error-shape.md`). No note gives a status for a new not-found or not-author error.
4. **Ownership:** A comment belongs to the user in `authorId` (`code-comment-ownership.md`). The ownership note says a comment that is not found, or that belongs to someone else, returns 404 with an empty body.

## Rule checks

| Rule (source) | Value in code (file:line) | Value from rule | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window (`policy-edit-window.md`) | 15 minutes, `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000` (`app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:563`) | 30 minutes | **FLAG** |
| Edit window, cited source (`article.service.ts:562`) | Code comment says "from policy-edit-window.md (15 minutes after createdAt)" | The note says 30 minutes | **FLAG** (the comment misquotes the note) |
| Marker field is nullable (`policy-edited-at-marker.md`) | `editedAt DateTime?` (`app/src/prisma/schema.prisma:30`) | Nullable timestamp | PASS |
| Marker null until first edit (same) | Migration adds the column with no default (`migration.sql:4`) | Null until first edit | PASS |
| Marker set on each edit (same) | `editedAt: now` in the update (`article.service.ts:614`) | Set to edit time | PASS |
| Migration does not change existing rows (same) | Only `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` in `migration.sql:4`, no `UPDATE` | No change to existing rows | PASS |
| Undo note for each migration (`policy-release-checklist.md`) | `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` (`migration.sql:1`) | One-line undo note | PASS |
| Run `prisma migrate deploy` on a fresh database (`policy-release-checklist.md`) | Not run. No database is available in this review | Required before ship | NOT VERIFIED |
| Error body shape (`policy-error-response.md`) | 422 `{errors:{body:["can't be blank"]}}` (`article.service.ts:574`). 404 and 403 bodies also use `errors` (`article.service.ts:594`, `:600`, `:604`) | `errors` key, no wrapper | PASS |
| Validation status 422 (`code-error-shape.md`) | 422 for empty body (`article.service.ts:574`) | 422 | PASS |
| Not-found and not-author status (`code-comment-ownership.md`) | Not-author returns 403 (`article.service.ts:568`, used at `:594`) | 404 | **FLAG** |
| Not-found and not-author body (`code-comment-ownership.md` vs `policy-error-response.md`) | Not-found returns 404 with an `errors` body (`article.service.ts:590`) | Ownership note says empty body. Error-response policy says `errors` key | See conflict below |
| Owner is `authorId` (`code-comment-ownership.md`) | Owner check `comment.authorId !== userId` (`article.service.ts:593`) | `authorId` | PASS |
| Expired-edit status (no rule) | 403 (`article.service.ts:569`, used at `:600`) | No rule gives a status. `policy-edit-window.md` only says "refuses" | NO RULE FOUND (not flagged on status) |
| Test location and naming (`code-test-layout.md`) | `app/src/tests/services/article.service.edit-comment.test.ts`, uses `prisma-mock` | Unit tests under `app/src/tests/services`, `*.test.ts`, mocked DB | PASS (not run) |

Rules not touched by this diff, so not checked: `code-auth-header.md`, `code-jwt-settings.md`, `policy-soft-delete.md`, `policy-article-list-limit.md`.

## Source conflict: non-author status and body

- `code-comment-ownership.md` says a non-owner gets 404 with an empty body. That note describes `deleteComment`.
- `policy-error-response.md` says new error responses must use the `errors` body. An empty body would break it.
- I followed `code-comment-ownership.md` for the status, so non-author should be 404. I followed `policy-error-response.md` for the body shape, so the body must still be an `errors` object, not empty. The ownership note describes existing behavior, and the policy governs new error responses.

The code's own comment (`article.service.ts:561-562`) cites `specs/feature-1-comment-editing.md` for the 403 choice. That file is not one of the named rule sources, so I did not read it or rely on it.

The unit tests pass the window and status values through the exported constants, so they would not catch these mismatches.

## Verdict

FLAGS:
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:563`: edit window is 15 minutes; `policy-edit-window.md` says 30.
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:568` and `:594`: non-author status is 403; `code-comment-ownership.md` says 404.

**NOT APPROVED**
